description: Golden regression fixture for WristMET. 'windows' are model-space windows (right-wrist frame, 20 Hz, m/s^2 and rad/s) rounded to 3 decimals, taken from the public Zenodo dataset (CC BY 4.0, doi:10.5281/zenodo.14858226). 'expected' holds the outputs of the build-time scikit-learn/XGBoost models and of the numpy evaluator for the demographics below.
